comment: wintty.c render_status() ends a row that got shorter with cl_end(), which erases the rest of the terminal row, not just the columns the old text covered. With statuslines:3 the bottom map row prints over the first status row; on the castle level ^F maps its full-width bottom wall there. Polymorphing into a newt turns St:18/05 into St:18, and the erase removes the wall beyond the old row's end too.
